chunks: Aban narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
A ram suffices for a man and for his household; he offers it as a sacrifice on their behalf.

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ: the members of his household included in the offering
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man on whose behalf the sacrifice is made
key_terms.الْكَبْشُ: a ram offered as the sacrificial animal
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient and fulfills the required offering

ai.seo_question: Does one ram suffice as a sacrificial offering for a man and his household?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one ram is sufficient as an uḍḥiyah for a man and his household. It indicates a legal ruling concerning sacrificial offering and shows the inclusion of one’s family in a single sacrifice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3050 - It is narrated by Aban from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (as), who said:
"A ram suffices for a man and his household; he may offer it as a sacrifice on their behalf."
